name: 922 Batch Repeater
description: Copy repeat orders from previous 922 batches - prompts for batch number when run. Also maintains the 922 MPL workbook: writes the new batch's PO column into the PO 321+ sheet and updates the MASTER PARTS catalog (repeat counts, batch history, alternate part names). Labels each repeat's Teams card with the REPEAT label and moves it to the batch's MODEL CHECK bucket via a Power Automate webhook.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Sync the '922 QTDR Production Packages' folder. The new batch's order folders should already exist (922 Setup's folder step).
Keep '922 MPL.xlsx' in place - the app reads the PO matrix from it and also updates it.
For card tagging, the D922 Planner and the repeat-tagger flow need to be set up.
how_it_works: Enter the batch. The app finds which orders were made in a prior batch (repeats) and lets you pick which to pull.
It copies each repeat's order folder into REPEAT BATCHES and distributes that repeat's CAD prints and binder into the matching current order folders.
It tags each repeat's Teams card REPEAT and moves it to MODEL CHECK, and folds the batch into the 922 Master Parts List.
output: A REPEAT BATCHES folder with the pulled repeats, CAD and binders distributed to matching orders, updated Teams cards, and an updated 922 MPL.

fields.label: Base Directory
fields.description: Path to '922 QTDR Production Packages' folder. Leave blank to auto-discover from OneDrive.
fields.placeholder: C:\Users\YourName\American Steel & Alum\Communication site - Electric Boat ASA Docs\Pilot Program\922 QTDR Production Packages

fields.label: Spreadsheet Filename
fields.description: Name of the Excel file (defaults to 922 MPL.xlsx).

validation.message: Must be an Excel file (.xls or .xlsx)

fields.label: Update MPL PO columns
fields.description: When on, the new batch's 'PO {n}' column is written into the PO 321+ sheet from the batch root's order folder names (existing cells are never overwritten).

fields.label: Update MASTER PARTS catalog
fields.description: When on, every order in the batch's PO workbook is folded into the MPL's MASTER PARTS sheet - new parts appended, repeats updated (times made, batch history, alternate part names). Re-runs are safe: a batch already recorded is skipped.

fields.label: Repeat Tagger Webhook URL (override)
fields.description: Leave blank to use TechDeck's built-in REPEAT-labeling flow (adds the REPEAT label to each repeat's Teams card and moves it to the batch's MODEL CHECK bucket). Only set this to point at a different Power Automate flow. Use the Dry run toggle below to preview without posting.

fields.label: Dry run (preview only)
fields.description: When on, the REPEAT-tagging payload is built and saved but not posted, and the MPL changes are computed and logged but not saved. Folder copying is NOT affected by this toggle.
